name: Dynamic Host-Based Routing, Per-Site Policy Execution & DNS-Rebinding Guard
invariants_enforced: Zero-restart dynamic routing matching incoming Host against HostRegistry
Unknown hosts rejected with 404 UNKNOWN_HOST and X-WAF-Action: REJECT_UNKNOWN_HOST
Per-site policy execution: blocking mode blocks attacks, monitor mode observes attacks
Runtime DNS-rebinding and SSRF protection with short TTL cache
Always blocks 169.254.0.0/16, fe80::/10, 0.0.0.0/8, multicast, and cloud metadata
Optional private origin toggle (WAF_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ORIGINS) for local dev / Docker
Nginx Host and X-Forwarded-Host header preservation ($http_host)
Tenant and site tagged async telemetry forwarding to Control Plane
Legacy single-upstream mode 100% backward-compatible when WAF_DYNAMIC_ROUTING_ENABLED=false
